Landing on the Design page fires a background models-list fetch that 400s then silently self-retries ~25s later (confirmed via trace.network on both a passing and failing iteration - the ONLY difference was whether this retry had finished by the time Add Model was clicked). Iterations with fewer preceding fields (e.g. User Defined Allocations, no Calculate step) reach Add Model too fast otherwise. No visible DOM signal to poll on, so a flat wait.
